length_inputs.short: Hello, this is a reproducible speech test on a single graphics card.
length_inputs.long: Today we are testing a local speech generation service on a single graphics card. We record the software versions, deployment settings, memory usage, and request latency so that another contributor can reproduce the experiment. This longer passage helps us observe how the service behaves when the generated audio lasts longer than a short greeting.

performance_method.kv: Three independent AB/BA/AB rounds; n30 per c1/2/4 cell after n8 shape-prewarm; retained disk caches.

admission_graph.input_population: 20 IDs repeat one fixed text per length; controlled length experiment, not diverse traffic
admission_graph.replication: Two warm sweeps in each fresh profile process; not independent process replications
admission_graph.inference: Report per-sweep ranges. No statistical speedup or production latency guarantee

performance_method.units: audio_s_per_s = generated audio seconds / benchmark seconds
performance_method.scope: Raw per-cell benchmark values, unrounded. The upstream detailed JSON does not save per-request audio TTFP/RTF arrays.

device_scope: 200ms whole-device samples across startup, serving and shutdown. Peak offsets are relative to the first sample; health is relative to process launch. A 2s margin separates peak phases; the origins differ by sampler/launch overhead. First/last offsets are occurrences of the maximum, not a claim that memory stayed at that value throughout.
cold_scope: Startup to health includes built-in warmup; first external streaming request separately saved; caches retained
inventory_scope: Selected live CUDA tensor storage deduplicated across aliases. Parameters and registered buffers are separate. Selected audio tensors include CFM inputs, graph inputs/outputs and retained request state. Opaque graph pools, transient VAE/CFM workspaces and other allocations remain unassigned. Allocated/reserved/whole-device samples are distinct; reserved includes allocated. Ready snapshots follow startup. B peaks cover ready onward; C/D after-repeat peaks reset after shape prewarm. None are full-startup allocator peaks. Diagnostic runs are separate from latency.
